Source: Patients with chiari malformation type one ( CM -1 ) headache may be mistaken by chronic migraines or other causes of headache, so analysis of headache related to CM-1 is corner stone in early diagnosis of the disease.
Luganda: Abalwadde abalumizibwa omutwe ogwa chiari malformation type one ( CM -1 ) bayinza okubuzibwabuzibwa n’omutwe omuteezi oba ebirala ebireeta Okulumizibwa Omutwe, kale nno okwekaliriza okulumizibwa Omutwe okwekwanya ne CM-1 kikulu nnyo mu kukebera amangu obulwadde buno.
Yoruba: Àwọn aláìsàn tó ní orí fífọ́ chiari malformation type one ( CM -1 ) lé è ṣi chronic migraines gbé síra wọn tàbí àwọn nǹkan mìíràn tó ń fa orí fífọ́, nítorí bẹ́ẹ̀ ìtúpalẹ̀ orí fífọ́ tó jọ mọ́ CM-1 jẹ́ ohun tó ṣe pàkàkì nínú ìtètè ṣàyẹ̀wò àìsàn náà.

Hausa: Ana iya bisa kuskure nuna majiyyata masu ciwon kai na gurɓacewar ƙoƙon kai nau’i na ɗaya na chiari (CM-1) a matsayin masu matsanancin ciwon kai na ɓari guda ko wasu dalilai na ciwon kai, don haka, nazarin ciwon kai da ke da alaƙa da CM-1 ginshiƙi ne wajen gano cuta a farkon ta.

Amharic: ቺያሪ ማልሮርሜሽን አይነት አንድ (ቺ.ማ-1) የአንድ ሰው የራስ ቅል በጣም ትንሽ ወይመ የተበላሸ ሲሆን  የሚፈጠር የሜዲካል ሁኔታ ነው፤ ይህም አንጎል ላይ ከልክ ያለፈ ጫና ይፈጥራል፡፡

Source: In 2020, Sudanese researchers reported distinct early headache symptoms of the condition, which can help clinicians to recognise and assist such patients as soon as possible.
Luganda: Mu 2020, abanoonyereza Abasudani baategeeza nti waaliwo okukenga obubonero bw’obulwadde obwo nga bukyali, ekiyinza okuyamba abasawo abakebezi okukenga n’okuyamba abalwadde ab’engeri eyo amangu ddala nga bwe kisoboka.
Yoruba: Ní ọdún 2020, àwọn aṣèwádìí tí wọ́n jẹ́ ará ìlú Sudan ròyìn ìyàtọ̀ ipò ààmì àìsàn orí fífọ́, tí ó lè ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́ fún àwọn aṣètọ́jú láti dáamọ̀ àti láti ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́ fún irúfẹ́ àwọn aláìsàn bẹ́ẹ̀ ní kíákíá.
Zulu: Ngo-2020, abacwaningi baseSudan babike izimpawu ezihlukene zekhanda elibuhlungu zakuqala zalesi simo, ezingasiza odokotela ukuthi babone futhi basize iziguli ezinjalo ngokushesha okukhulu.
Hausa: A cikin shekarar 2020, masu bincike na Sudan sun ba da rahoton alamun ciwon kai na farko na yanayin, wanda zai iya taimakawa likitocin su gane da kuma taimaka wa irin waɗannan marasa lafiya da wuri-wuri.
Northern Sotho: Ka 2020, banyakišiši ba Sudan ba begile maswao a bolwetši bja go opa ga hlogo ao a bonagalago gabonolo, ao a ka thušago dingaka go lemoga le go thuša balwetši bao ka pela ka moo go ka kgonagalago.
Amharic: በ2020፣ የሱዳን ተመራማሪዎች ስለ ሁኔታው ለየት ያሉ የራስ ምታት ምልክቶችን ዘግበዋል እነዚህም የክሊኒክ ባለሞያዎች መሰል ታማማዊችን በተቻለ ፍጥነት ቀድመው እንዲያውቁ እና እንዲያግዙ ሊረዳ ይችላል፡፡

Source: CM-1 patients experience headaches, but because this is such a common symptom, doctors often miss their condition and thus do not recommend appropriate treatments.
Luganda: Abalwadde ba CM-1 bafuna okulumwa emitwe naye olw’okuba akabonero ako kalabika nnyo, abasawo batera okusubwa embeera eyo era bwe batyo ne batasemba bujjanjabi bubutuukirako.
Yoruba: Àwọn aláìsàn CM-1 tí wọ́n ní ìrírí orí fífọ́, àmọ́ nítorí pé ó jẹ́ ààmì àìsàn tó wọ́pọ̀, àwọn dọ́kítà má ń ṣi ipò wọn gbé síra nítorí náà wọ́n kì í sọ ìtọ́jú tó bújúmu.
Zulu: Iziguli ze-CM-1 zithola ubuhlungu bekhanda, kodwa ngenxa yokuthi lokhu kuyisibonakaliso esivamile, odokotela bavame ukuphuthelwa isimo sabo futhi ngaleyo ndlela abancomi ukwelashwa okufanele.
Hausa: Marasa lafiya na CM-1 suna fuskantar ciwon kai, amma saboda wannan alama ce ta kowa, likitoci sukan rasa yanayinsu kuma don haka, ba sa ba da shawarar hanyoyin da suka dace.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši ba CM-1 ba itemogela go opa ga hlogo, eupša ka baka la gore se e le leswao le le tlwaelegilego, dingaka gantši ga di lemoge malwetši a bona gomme ka gona tša palelwa ke go šišinya dikalafo tša maleba.
Amharic: የቺ.ማ-1 ታማሚዎች ራስ ምታት የሚያጋጥማቸው ሲሆን፣ ይህ ግን በጣም የተለመደ ምልክት ስለሆነ ዶክተሮች አብዛኛውን ጊዜ ሳያስተውሉት ይቀራሉ በዚህም ምክንያት የሚገባውን ህክምና አይጠቁሙም፡፡

Source: So the headaches get worse.
Luganda: Kale nno okulumwa omutwe ne kweyongera.
Yoruba: Bẹ́ẹ̀ orí fífọ́ náà burú si.
Zulu: Ngakho ubuhlungu bekhanda buba bubi nakakhulu.
Hausa: Don haka ciwon kai na ƙara tsananta.
Northern Sotho: Ka gona go opa ga dihlogo go gakalela pele.
Amharic: በዚህም ምክንያት ራስ ምታቱ ይባባሳል፡፡

Source: Researchers wanted to find out how many people suffer with CM-1, and they wanted to describe their symptoms in more detail so that clinicians can look for specific traits.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baayagala okuzuula engeri abantu gye babonaabonamu ne CM-1, era baayagala okunnyonnyola obubonero bwabwe mu bwesovvu obusingako kiyambe abasawo abakebezi okutunuulira obubonero obutegeerekeka.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ ṣe ìwádìí iye àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n joró CM-1, tí wọ́n sì fẹ́ ṣàpèjúwe ààmì àìsàn wọn ní kíkún kí àwọn aṣètọ́jú lè ṣàwárí àwọn àbùdà nàá.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bebefuna ukuthola ukuthi bangaki abantu abahlushwa i-CM-1, futhi bafuna ukuchaza izimpawu zabo kabanzi ukuze odokotela bakwazi ukubheka izici ezithile.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun so su gano yawan mutanen da ke fama da CM-1, kuma suna so su bayyana alamun su dalla-dalla don ƙananan likitoci su nemi takamaiman halaye.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go utolla gore ke batho ba bakae bao ba nago le bolwetši bja CM-1, gomme ba nyaka go hlaloša maswao a tšona ka botlalo gore dingaka di kgone go lebelela mekgwa ye itšego.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች በቺ.ማ-1 ምን ያህል ሰዎች እንደሚሰቃዩ ማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር፤ በተጨማሪ የክሊኒክ ባለሞያዎች የተወሰኑ ባህሪያትን እንዲፈልጉ ምልክቶቻቸውን በበለጠ ዝርዝር ማብራራት ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

Source: The researchers studied 18 CM-1 patients from the Khartoum state hospital in Sudan.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baatunuulira abalwadde ba CM-1 18 okuva mu ddwaliro lya gavumeti erya Khartoum mu Sudan.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe ìwádìí àwọn aláìsàn CM-1 tó tó 18 láti ilé ìwòsàn ìjọba Khartoum ní Sudan.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bacwaninge iziguli eziyi-18 ze-CM-1 esibhedlela sesifunda sase-Khartoum eSudan.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi nazarin marasa lafiya guda18 masu CM-1 daga asibitin jihar Khartoum da ke ƙasar Sudan.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba nyakišišitše balwetši ba 18 ba CM-1 go tšwa sepetleleng sa mmušo sa Khartoum go la Sudan.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በሱዳን ካርቱም የመንግስት ሆስፒታል 18 ቺ.ማ-1 ታማሚዎችን አጥንተዋል፡፡

Source: All patients were scheduled for a “decompressive surgery”, which would remove the pressure from (or decompress) the brain.
Luganda: Abalwadde bonna baateekebwateekebwa “okulongoosa okukendeeza obulumi”, ekyandiggyewo okunyigiriza mu bwongo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ètò “iṣẹ́ abẹ eegun ẹ̀yìn” fún gbogbo àwọn aláìsàn, tí ó lè yọ ìdààmù kuro ninu (tàbí tó lè jẹ́ kó dínkù) ọpọlọ.
Zulu: Zonke iziguli zazihlelelwe "ukuhlinzwa kwe-decompressive", okwakuzosusa ingcindezi (noma i-decompress) ebuchosheni.
Hausa: An tsara duk marasa lafiya don "tiyatar gyara matsatsun jijiyoyi a ƙashin baya", wanda zai cire matsin daga (ko rage matse) ƙwaƙwalwar.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši ka moka ba diretšwe peakanyo ya go dirwa “karo ya go tloša kgatelelo”, yeo e tla tlošago kgatelelo (goba go go tloša kgatelelo) bjokong.
Amharic: ሁሉም ታማሚዎች “ለማስተንፈሻ ቀዶ ጥገና” ተቀጥረው ነበር፡፡ ይህም ከአንጎል ላይ ጫናውን ያስወግዳል (ወይም ያስተነፍሳል)፡፡

Source: The researchers monitored the patients' headaches before and after surgery, looking specifically at the headache type, site, pain levels and duration.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baalondoola okulumwa omutwe mu balwadde nga okulongoosebwa tekunnaba ne nga kuwedde, nga batunuulira kika kya mutwe, ekifo, obungi bw’obulumi n’ebbanga obulumi lye bumala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ń ṣe àmójútó orí fífọ́ àwọn aláìsàn ṣíwájú àti lẹ́yìn iṣẹ́ abẹ, pàápàá jùlọ irúfẹ́ orí fífọ́ tó jẹ́, irúfẹ́ ipò, bí ó ṣé ń dun ni sí àti iye àkókò.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqaphe amakhanda eziguli ngaphambi nangemva kokuhlinzwa, bebheka ngokukhethekile uhlobo lwekhanda elibuhlungu, indawo, amazinga obuhlungu kanye nobude besikhathi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun lura da ciwon kai na marasa lafiya kafin da bayan tiyata, suna kallon nau'in ciwon kai, ɓangare, matakan ciwo da kuma tsawon lokaci.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lekodišišitše go opa ga hlogo ga balwetši pele le ka morago ga karo, ba lebeletše kudukudu go mohuta wa go opa ke hlogo, lefelo, dikelo tša bohloko le bogolo bja nako.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ከቀዶ ጥገና በፊት እና በኋላ የታማሚዎችን ራስ ምታት የተከታተሉ ሲሆን በተለይ ስለ ራስ ምታቱ አይነት ፣ መገኛ ፣ የህመም ደረጃ እና ቆይታን ለይተው አይተዋል፡፡

Source: They also looked at eye and vision symptoms before and after the surgery.
Luganda: Era baatunuulira n’obubonero bw’oku maaso mu kulaba ng’okulongoosa kuwedde ne nga tekunnaba.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún wo ojú àti ààmì àìsàn ríríran ṣáájú àti lẹ́yìn iṣẹ́ abẹ.
Zulu: Baphinde babheka izimpawu zamehlo nesokubona ngaphambi nangemuva kokuhlinzwa.
Hausa: Sun kuma kalli alamun ido da alamun gani kafin da kuma bayan tiyata.
Northern Sotho: Ba lebeletše le maswao a go amana le mahlo le go kgona go bona pele le ka morago ga karo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ ከቀዶ ጥገና በፊት እና በኋላ የአይን እና የእያታ ምልክቶችን አይተዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers found that patients with CM-1 had pressure or throbbing headaches at the back of their heads, and that bending over or coughing worsened the headache.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baazuula nti abalwadde abalina CM-1 baalina okunyigiriza oba omutwe ogwamaanyi enkoto, era nti okukutama oba okukolola byaleeteranga omutwe okweyongera.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ri pé àwọn aláìsàn CM-1 ní orí fífọ́ ní ẹ̀yìn orí wọn, àti pé dídoríkodò tàbí wíwúkọ́ tún jẹ́ kí orí fífọ́ nàá burú si.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi iziguli ezine-CM-1 zinengcindezi noma ikhanda elibuhlungu ngemuva kwamakhanda azo, nokuthi ukugoba noma ukukhwehlela kwenza ikhanda libe libi kakhulu.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa marasa lafiya da ke ɗauke da CM-1 suna da matsi ko ciwon kai a bayan kawunansu, kuma sunkuyar da kai ko tari na ƙara tsananta ciwon kan.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gore balwetši ba CM-1 ba be ba na le kgatelelo goba go opa ga dihlogo tše di opago ka sekoding sa bona, le gore go inamela fase goba go gohlola go be go gakatša go opa ga hlogo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የቺ.ማ-1 ታማሚዎች ጫና ወይም ትር ትር የሚል ራስ ምታት ከጭንቅላታቸው ጀርባ እንዳላቸው እና ወደፊት ሲያዘነብሉ ወይም ሲስሉ ደግሞ ራስ ምታታቸው እንደሚባባስ አግኝተዋል፡፡

Source: Most of the patients had vision problems, and half said that they had neck and back pain too.
Luganda: Abalwadde abasinga baalina obuzibu mu kulaba, ate ekitundu ku bo baagamba nti baalina obulumi mu nsingo ne mu mugongo.
Yoruba: Púpọ̀ nínú àwọn aláìsàn náà ní ìṣòro ríríran, àti pé ìdajì sọ pé àwọn ní ọrùn àti ẹ̀yìn dídùn.
Zulu: Iningi leziguli lalinenkinga yokubona, kanti ingxenye yalo yathi yayinentamo nomgogodla futhi.
Hausa: Yawancin marasa lafiya suna da matsalolin gani, kuma rabi sun ce suna da ciwon wuya da kuma baya.
Northern Sotho: Bontši bja balwetši ba bile le mathata a go kgona go bona, le gore seripagare sa bona ba boletše gore ba itemogetše bohloko molaleng le mokokotlong.
Amharic: አብዛኛዎቹ ታማሚዎች የእይታ ችግሮች ነበሩባቸው እና ግማሽ የሚሆኑት የአንገት እና የጀርባ ህመም እንዳለባቸውም ተናግረዋል፡፡

Source: On a scale of 1-10, where 10 was most severe, most patients rated their headache as 6.8.
Luganda: Ku kigero ekya 1-10, nga 10 kye kigero ekiraga okulumizibwa ennyo, abalwadde abasinga baalaga ekigero nga kiri ku 6.8.
Yoruba: Lórí òṣùwọ̀n 1-10, tí 10 jẹ́ èyí tó nira jù, púpọ̀ nínú àwọn aláìsàn ṣe òṣùwọ̀n orí fífọ́ wọn sí 6.8.
Zulu: Esikalini se-1-10, lapho i-10 yayinzima kakhulu, iziguli eziningi zilinganise ikhanda labo njenge-6.8.
Hausa: A kan sikelin 1-10, inda 10 ya fi tsanani, yawancin marasa lafiya sun ƙididdige ciwon kai a matsayin 6.8.
Northern Sotho: Go sekala sa 1-10, moo 10 e bego e emela bohloko gošoro, balwetši ba bantši ba laeditše kelo ya go opa ga dihlogo tša bona go ba 6.8.
Amharic: 10 እጅግ በጣም ከባዱ በሆነበት ከ1-10 ልኬት አብዛኛዎቹ ታማሚዎች ራስ ምታታቸውን 6.8 ደረጃ ሰጥተውታል፡፡

Source: They also noticed that the patients’ headaches were relieved after the surgery.
Luganda: Era baakiraba nti obulumi bw’omutwe mu balwadde bwakendeera ng’okulongoosa kuwedde.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣàkíyèsí pé orí fífọ́ àwọn aláìsàn tí lọọlẹ̀ lẹ́yìn iṣẹ́ abẹ.
Zulu: Baphinde baqaphela ukuthi ubuhlungu bekhanda ezigulini badamba ngemva kokuhlinzwa.
Hausa: Sun kuma lura cewa ciwon kai na marasa lafiya ya sami sauƙi bayan tiyata.
Northern Sotho: Ba lemogile le gore go opa ga dihlogo ga balwetši go okobetše morago ga go dirwa karo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ የታማሚዎች ራስ ምታት ከቀዶ ጥገና በኋላ እንደተሻሻለ አስተውለዋል፡፡

Source: The results from this study agreed with other studies that looked at CM-1 symptoms.
Luganda: Ebyava mu kunoonyereza kuno bikkaanya n’ebyo ebyokunoonyereza okulala okwatunuulira obubonero bwa CM-1.
Yoruba: Àwọn èsì láti inú ìwádìí yìí ti gbà pẹ̀lú àwọn ìwádìí tó kù tí wọ́n wo ààmì àìsàn CM-1.
Zulu: Imiphumela evela kulolu cwaningo ivumelane nezinye izifundo ezibheke izimpawu ze-CM-1.
Hausa: Sakamakon wannan binciken ya yarda da wasu nazarin da suka kalli alamun CM-1.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo go tšwa dinyakišišong tše go dumelelane le dinyakišišo tše dingwe tšeo di bego di lebeletše maswao a CM-1.
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናት ውጤቶች ሌሎች የቺ.ማ-1 ምልክቶችን ካጠኑ ጥናቶች ጋር ይስማማሉ፡፡

Source: These findings show that patients with CM-1 headaches have distinct features that clinicians can use to diagnose CM-1 early.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kulaga nti abalwadde abalumizibwa omutwe CM-1 balina obubonero abasawo abakebera bwe basobola okukozesa okukebera CM-1 nga bukyali.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí fi hàn pé àwọn aláìsàn pẹ̀lú orí fífọ́ CM-1 ní àbùdá tó yàtọ̀ tí àwọn aṣètọ́jú lè tètè lò láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò CM-1.
